about: Neutral, Claude-shaped guard cases that scripts/test-hooks.sh cannot express, replayed by `x4guard conformance` for EVERY adapter. test-hooks.sh has no PowerShell probe at all, so without these a shell-routing bug (a PowerShell command judged as bash) is invisible. Each `expect` is a CONTROL: the guards are asked first, and a case whose guards no longer say `expect` stops the run with exit 2 -- a deliberate guard-policy change updates this file in the same commit. Tokens: {TK} the dump sandbox's toolkit root (native separators), {TKP} its forward-slash form, {TKMSYS} its Git Bash form (/c/...), {TMP} its parent. `files` are created before the case runs. `relative`: the case's path is relative, so an adapter that ignores the agent's working directory gets it wrong. Never edit this file to make an adapter pass.
